summary.text: Tyler Bass is the Republican nominee in Minnesota's 3rd Congressional District, after winning the August 11, 2026 primary over Quentin Wittrock. A general contractor and small-business owner, he describes himself as running on stronger oversight to prevent government fraud and on prioritizing American workers.

paragraphs.text: Grew up in Blooming Prairie, Minnesota, and graduated from Blooming Prairie High School.
Earned a bachelor's degree from Luther College in 2010, where, according to his Ballotpedia survey, he studied exercise science and played college football as a running back.
Says he struggled to find work after graduating during the 2011-2012 economic downturn and started a fitness website with his last $250.
Lists general contractor as his profession; MPR News describes him as a business owner. He says he lives in Minnetonka.
Won the August 11, 2026 Republican primary with 55.4% of the vote over Quentin Wittrock.

sources.title: Minnesota congressional races set after Tuesday primary (MPR News, Aug. 12, 2026)
